{{Quote|I've seen the Forbidden Gardens of the Nuswatta. I've seen&mdash;and sacked&mdash;the innermost chamber of the Poborandurannum of Natinati.|Jabba to Bib Fortuna|<ref name="Betrayal" />}}
'''Poborandurannum''' was a temple located on<ref name="Betrayal" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Natinati system/Legends|Natinati system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Natinati]]. It was considered sacred<ref name="CSWENatinati">{{CSWECite|II|363|Natinati}}</ref> and had an innermost chamber inside of it.<ref name="Betrayal" /> At some point before [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="DHCT">The date of ''[[Jabba the Hutt: Betrayal]]'' is established to be [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]] by {{DarkHorse|url=Zones/StarWars/Timeline|text=Comics Timeline}}. As Jabba mentions sacking Poborandurannum in the story, the event must have happened by that date.</ref> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] visited Natinati to explore Poborandurannum<ref name="CSWENatinati" /> and sacked the temple's innermost chamber during his visit.<ref name="Betrayal" /> In 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="DHCT" /> the Hutt mentioned Poborandurannum and its sacking to his [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] aboard his<ref name="Betrayal" /> [[Star Jewel/Legends|space yacht]]<ref name="StarJewel">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Jabba's Space Cruiser}}</ref> while he returned to his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Betrayal" />

==Behind the scenes==
Poborandurannum was first mentioned in ''[[Jabba the Hutt: Betrayal]]'', the fourth and final issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Jabba the Hutt]]'' series of one-shot [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] written by [[Jim Woodring]].<ref name="Betrayal" /> The comic was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[February 20]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54267/star_wars_jabba_the_hutt_-_betrayal_1995_1|text=Star Wars: Jabba the Hutt - Betrayal (1995) #1}}</ref>
